runs.name: Mitsui & Co., Ltd.
runs.entry: **DISPATCHER'S TICKER ERROR, declared first.** The queue's next name was MTSUY, which is Mitsubishi Corporation's ADR; the overnight cycle's brief described Mitsui & Co. (TSE 8031) under that ticker. The analyst found the error at Step 0 (Mitsui's own IR page gives MITSY, 1 ADR = 20 shares, depositary Citibank) and ran Mitsui. The run was committed as `Test Runs/2026-10-12 Run - MTSUY Mitsui and Co.md` with its folder `_research 2026-10-12 MTSUY` and renamed at the fold, contents unchanged except the POSITION NOTE the template gives the dispatcher; the record is `Test Runs/ADDENDUM 2026-10-12 - the MTSUY brief that ran Mitsui, the dispatcher's ticker error.md`. MITSY is not in `Screens/_daily/_v5_rerun_order.txt` (a holding, reviewed under the holdings framework); this is an unordered v5 purchase run of a held name, folded under operator rule 10(c) because it was received, and MITSY is taken back out of the done file. **MTSUY (Mitsubishi) stays owed and is the next cycle's name.** Price **¥4,775** (Tokyo close 2026-10-09; 2026-10-12 a Japanese holiday) x **2,839,906,064 shares** (2,864,666,576 issued at 2026-03-31 less treasury, 107th Annual Securities Report) = cap **¥13,560.6 bn**; sovereign **4.14%** (30-year JGB, Ministry of Finance). Primary document the English Annual Securities Report for FY ended 2026-03-31 (filed in Japan 2026-06-12), earlier years' reports and the Q1 FY2027 presentation; no SEC filings since the 2010 20-F. Q1 IN (by parts; Mineral & Metal Resources decides, 36.9% of FY2022-26 segment profit; the ore price is the open variable, the filer discloses no price assumption) · Q2 IN (low-cost Pilbara iron ore through BHP- and Rio-operated ventures; MMR 8.9% a year after tax on its assets FY2016-26, the FY2016 loss included) · Q3 against (capital-heavy) · Q4 against (guidance, a featured adjusted cash figure, recurring impairments) · Q5 integrity IN, ability undecided · Q6 undecided, slightly against · **Q7 OUT**: value range **¥2,723 to ¥4,796** (cycle base FY2017-26, all-equity; literal window FY2022-26 ¥4,152 to ¥5,999), expected return 2.8% to 4.9% at the price, inside a range narrower than three to one. Owner cash after all spending ¥341.0 bn a year over the cycle, ¥504.2 bn FY2022-26. **Fair price ¥516 a share all-equity (ADS $65)**, equity-only ¥1,758 (ADS $222); the analyst reports the all-equity figure as very sensitive to ¥4.46 tn of net debt. Evidence against: owner cash after all spending about 40% of profit; Robe River in the costlier Pilbara system; about ¥1 tn of collateral posted in FY2026, ¥1.15 tn of guarantees, ¥279.8 bn of Russian exposure. Not obtained: Mitsubishi Corp's report (HTTP 403), Itochu's full ten-year series, Rio Tinto's Pilbara costs, the equity-method investees' accounts. Contamination declared: four file names seen in a filtered listing (none opened) and the filed 9.82% National Indemnity holding (given no weight). Process exceptions the analyst confessed: the Q7 arithmetic run as a computation before Q3 to Q6 were written; a Q7 total quoted in Q6's first commit; ten-year averages corrected mid-run with a dated note; growth spending charged in proportion to the capped growth rate, confessed as a CONVENTION of this run. Defects raised for the operator: no brief step checks the ticker against the company before dispatch; the reporting convention might note an all-equity and equity-only divergence over threefold; Q5's ability verdict has no UNDECIDED. Dispatcher's quote check: 27 adjacent fragments, 0 slips (one flag at line 493 is the filer's plan wording, not a ledger quote). Acceptance test PASS.
runs.narr: Mitsui & Co. (TSE 8031), run under the queue's MTSUY slot by the dispatcher's ticker error (MTSUY is Mitsubishi, still owed). Business IN at Q1 and Q2 on low-cost Pilbara iron ore; OUT at Q7 at ¥4,775 against a ¥2,723 to ¥4,796 cycle range; fair ¥516 all-equity (ADS $65), ¥1,758 equity-only. A held name; the holding review is the place for the keep question.
